z03-review-march.observed_description: The year planner with one blue loop around box 3 and, reaching in from the right, an adult hand holding a blue whiteboard marker whose tip touches the end of the loop. Every box number 1 to 12 is still readable; no words.
z03-review-march.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared 3:2 only). One loop, on box 3; the hand makes it a fresh review picture.

z05-review-may.observed_description: The year planner with one loop around box 5, but the hand and marker sit far to the right with the tip pointing at box 8.
z05-review-may.note: Rejected: the marker points at box 8, so the picture could be read as month 8. Not installed; May returns in the review as a listening card without a picture.
